page.notes: Hebrew vowel pointing and some Latin abbreviations are hard to read at this scan resolution and may contain errors. The Hebrew forms in the Latin glosses (for example "מוֹרָאוֹ", "מוֹרִים", "מוֹרְטָה") are tentative. "quo etiam" is printed with an irregular letter form, transcribed as seen. Printed "מוֹרִישָׁם" appears twice and is copied as printed.
